whatIsGemini.name: what-is-gemini
whatIsGemini.title: Understanding Gemini AI Watermarks
whatIsGemini.label: About Gemini Watermarks
whatIsGemini.description: Google Gemini AI adds both visible and invisible watermarks to generated images. The visible watermark appears as a small blue diamond in the bottom corner, while SynthID technology embeds an invisible digital watermark in the image pixels for identification.

items.title: Visible Diamond Watermark
items.description: Gemini places a small blue diamond logo in the bottom corner (usually left or right) of AI-generated images for clear identification.

items.title: SynthID Invisible Watermark
items.description: Advanced digital watermark embedded directly in image pixels, undetectable to human eyes but identifiable by detection tools.

items.title: Dual Protection System
items.description: Both visible and invisible watermarks work together to ensure AI-generated content can be properly identified and attributed.
